title: Magnetohydrodynamics
description: A conducting fluid in a magnetic field carries the field with it and pushes current through it: the physics of the Sun's surface, of the geodynamo, and of a generator with no moving parts. Unlocks the MHD Generator.

puzzle.goal: A fluid of conductivity σ flows at speed u across a field B between two electrodes; the outside circuit takes a fraction k of the open-circuit voltage. Write p, the electrical output per cubic metre.
puzzle.name: Faraday generator
puzzle.ask: Find p in W/m³ for a seeded plasma: σ = @{σ} S/m, u = @{u} m/s, B = @{B} T, k = @{k}.
puzzle.method: The current density is j = σ(uB − E) with E = k·uB at the load; the power delivered is j·E.
